svg.title: Exhibition photography direction
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: Daylight-white halls; brand colour comes from
Credible crowds; no staged or artificial-looking
A Plum–Indigo gradient at up to 90% carries
Indigo-to-Plum overlay, left aligned copy, subject kept clear on the right.
Illustrative images supplied by the organiser. They are not photographs of a previous STFE edition.
